title: Concept: Requirement pointing at a local path
description: setup.cfg declares an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through setup.cfg (pypi).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk.
